CVE-2025-53644.title: OpenCV is an Open Source Computer Vision Library. Versions 4.10.0 ...
CVE-2025-53644.description: OpenCV is an Open Source Computer Vision Library. Versions 4.10.0 and 4.11.0 have an uninitialized pointer variable on stack that may lead to arbitrary heap buffer write when reading crafted JPEG images. Version 4.12.0 fixes the vulnerability.

CVE-2026-135290.title: OpenCV through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an infinit ...
CVE-2026-135290.description: OpenCV through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in YAMLParser::parse that allows attackers to cause denial of service via crafted YAML dash lines. Attackers can supply YAML files with a non-separator '-' line after the first document, opened through cv::FileStorage, to hang the thread at full CPU.
